rules.name: inline-style
rules.message: Inline style detected. Prefer Tailwind className or design-system component props when possible. Dynamic values (width, color from data) are acceptable.
rules.fix: For static styles: use className='...' with Tailwind. For dynamic values: consider CSS variables (var(--...)).

rules.name: raw-fetch-api
rules.message: Raw fetch to PallasTrade API. Use @pallastrade/sdk or @pallastrade/admin-sdk.
rules.fix: Use the typed SDK client: import { createClient } from '@pallastrade/sdk'

rules.name: model-create-outside-test
rules.message: Model.create/save outside spec directory. Use Factory Bot in tests, Service objects in app.
rules.fix: In tests: `create(:model_name)`. In app: use a proper service or repository pattern.

rules.name: after-save-callback
rules.message: after_save callback used. Consider PallasTrade::Subscriber for side effects.
rules.fix: Create a subscriber class and register it instead of using after_save.

rules.name: unscoped-store-query
rules.message: Unscoped query to PallasTrade model. Always scope through current_store.

rules.name: hardcoded-hex-color
rules.message: Hardcoded hex color. Use CSS custom properties from design tokens.
rules.fix: Replace with var(--color-...) from design tokens

rules.name: hand-edit-generated
rules.message: Hand-editing auto-generated files. Run the generation command instead.
rules.fix: Run the appropriate generate:types or generate:zod command

rules.name: unnecessary-view-host-app-override
rules.message: Admin view file exists in Host App but likely duplicates a Gem view. This project modifies Gem source files directly. Unless this is a net-new module (like ai/), move your changes into the Gem file at pallastrade_gems/pallastrade_admin/app/views/.
rules.fix: Move your changes to the corresponding file in the Gem, add `# PALLAS-CUSTOM:` comment, and delete this Host App copy.

rules.name: redirect-without-self-guard
rules.message: redirect() to a hardcoded static path without a self-redirect guard. When the fallback destination equals the current URL (e.g. API fails, markets=[] -> redirect('/us/en') from /us/en), it creates an infinite loop. Dynamic targets (template literals, variables) are exempt.
rules.fix: Add a guard before redirect: `if (target !== currentPath) { redirect(target); }`. Or use a dynamic target (template literal / variable). Also ensure fallback data does not come from a failed API returning empty collection.

rules.name: catch-returns-empty-collection
rules.message: API failure caught and converted to empty collection. This collapses 'unknown state' (API down) into 'known state' (empty result), which can cause downstream logic to incorrectly redirect, retry, or render invalid states.
rules.fix: Change `.catch(() => [])` to `.catch(() => null)`, then handle `null` separately: show degraded UI or skip the operation.
